title: ChatGPT and Claude for Coding
description: Learn how to use general-purpose LLM chat interfaces like ChatGPT and Claude to architect solutions, debug complex issues, and write code outside of your IDE.

data.text: While IDE-integrated tools are great for writing lines of code, web-based chat interfaces excel at high-level system design, explaining unfamiliar codebases, and brainstorming. Claude's Artifacts feature and ChatGPT's Advanced Data Analysis make them incredibly powerful for prototyping.
